label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat02Subtitle
text: *They've ambushed us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat03Subtitle
text: *They've ambushed our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat04Subtitle
text: *We have found their secret base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat05Subtitle
text: *They are coming from the far side of the lake

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat06Subtitle
text: *Their troops must be hidden in the forest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat07Subtitle
text: *I wonder what's across the river

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat08Subtitle
text: *Their hit-and-run attacks are proving inconvenient

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat09Subtitle
text: *The buggies are back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat10Subtitle
text: *Sneak attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat11Subtitle
text: *Crush that Inferno Cannon!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat12Subtitle
text: *The people are too afraid to come out from their homes

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xChat13Subtitle
text: *We must free them from this oppression!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO01Subtitle
text: *The people rise to support us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO10Subtitle
text: *General. Destroying the GLA statues will be critical to increasing our International Opinion and will boost support of our efforts amongst the population

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO11Subtitle
text: *They have dispatched a Toxic Tractor to clear our garrisonned structures!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO12Subtitle
text: *Our Dragon Tanks will be a high priority targetguard them well

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO13Subtitle
text: *Well done, sir. The destruction of the statue has caused world opinion to rise

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO16Subtitle
text: *Do not let them destroy the buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO17Subtitle
text: *Use the Neutron Shell to clear buildings without damaging them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO18Subtitle
text: *Beware! Their defensive structures are hidden with camo-netting

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO19Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA have the city well-defended. We need to clear them out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO20Subtitle
text: *You're making good progress, Commander. Much of the city is now free of GLA control

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO21Subtitle
text: *Sir! The city is rising up against our foes!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO22Subtitle
text: *General, we must clear the GLA from this area!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI03xXO23Subtitle
text: *Our International Opinion is high. Great work!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat01Subtitle
text: *They have almost escaped! We must stop them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat010Subtitle
text: *They are skirting the lake. Intercept them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat011Subtitle
text: *They're coming for our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat012Subtitle
text: *We have stopped the first wave of GLA!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat013Subtitle
text: *Again we have put them in their place!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat014Subtitle
text: *No one can stand to the might of China!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat015Subtitle
text: *Sun Tzu would be proud

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat016Subtitle
text: *Victory is ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat017Subtitle
text: *None shall pass

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat018Subtitle
text: *We will banish them from the skies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat019Subtitle
text: *Our power is unsurpassed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat02Subtitle
text: *Cut them off at the village!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat020Subtitle
text: *The Helix isn't the only powerhouse

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat03Subtitle
text: *We cannot let them get past that hill

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat04Subtitle
text: *They will surely pass by here. We should defend this area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat05Subtitle
text: *Here is another choke point

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat06Subtitle
text: *We should secure these buildings

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat07Subtitle
text: *What are they doing?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat08Subtitle
text: *Watch out for the toxin!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat09Subtitle
text: *We've been ambushed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat15Subtitle
text: *Our forces are in position. We are ready for anything

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xChat16Subtitle
text: *They are stronger than we thought. We need air support. Send in the Helix now!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO01Subtitle
text: *The GLA is sending forth another wave!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO02Subtitle
text: *This wave is retreating towards the north

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO03Subtitle
text: *They are retreating to the northeast

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO04Subtitle
text: *This wave is retreating to the east

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO05Subtitle
text: *The European Union is extremely pleased with our performance, General. We need to stay aggressive and eliminate the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO06Subtitle
text: *This force was only a diversion!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO07Subtitle
text: *General, they have a scud storm! We must spread out our troops to deny them a target!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO08Subtitle
text: *Waitthey're not targeting us

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO09Subtitle
text: *The GLA have no honor! They have decimated the village to clear a path!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO10Subtitle
text: *We should assemble a base to secure this region

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO11Subtitle
text: *Our Helix is the Overlord of the skies. Build more to help us control the area

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO12Subtitle
text: *Sir, I recommend placing Listening Outposts at key locations

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO13Subtitle
text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO14Subtitle
text: *Current Intel reports that the GLA are retreating towards this location. We will make our stand here. Do not permit any GLA units to leave this area. If too many of them escape, our mission will be a failure. Our new Helix Helicopter should assure your success. The appearance of our forces from the south will signal the completion of your main objective

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO15Subtitle
text: *A wave of GLA is approaching from the west

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO16Subtitle
text: *There is a wave of GLA approaching from the south

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO17Subtitle
text: *GLA forces have been spotted approaching from the southwest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO18Subtitle
text: *GLA forces incoming from the southeast

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO19Subtitle
text: *A wave of GLA forces are approaching from the southwest

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO20Subtitle
text: *Another GLA wave is approaching

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO21Subtitle
text: *Excellent work, sir. Intel confirms that you have destroyed the entire wave

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO22Subtitle
text: *The enemy is about to breach our defenses

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO23Subtitle
text: *Multiple Scud Storm launches detected

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO24Subtitle
text: *Our defenses have been breached commander, we have failed the mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO25Subtitle
text: *Commander, our forces from the south have arrived. Out mission was a success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO26Subtitle
text: *General, enemy forces are dangerously close to making their escape. We must deal with them quickly!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO27Subtitle
text: *GLA forces have been detected fleeing through this location. Move into defensive positions and await enemy contact

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO28Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 1 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO29Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 2 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO30Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 3 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO31Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 4 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO32Subtitle
text: *General, Wave 5 of the enemies retreat has been detected entering the area and intel has them moving along the path shown on the your radar

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO33Subtitle
text: *Our forces have arrived from the south. You have been successful in preventing the enemy retreat. Good job General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI04xXO34Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy forces have escaped to the North. We have failed the mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC01Subtitle
text: *It's time we corrected our mistake. Kill them all!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi05OfficerC02Subtitle
text: *Let us flush these rats from their holes. Death to the cowards!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf01Subtitle
text: *Thanks to your remarkable efforts in Halberstadt the GLA are all but finished. US intel has located the last GLA stronghold outside of Hamburg. Unfortunately we were too late to help the Americans in this area and the GLA captured their base. Build your forces and destroy both the GLA and US bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf02Subtitle
text: *The GLA have captured an old US base in the region and are building up. Your Final Objective is to Destroy both the US and GLA bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf03Subtitle
text: *The GLA have increased their stealth abilities, General. They can now stealth just about anything. We'll need to stay alert

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf04Subtitle
text: *Use your Listening Outposts to detect stealthed units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xBrf05Subtitle
text: *General, I suggest you first concentrate your attack on the US base. We need to take out their Particle Cannons

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xChat01Subtitle
text: *It feels like we are on an Easter Egg hunt, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin01Subtitle
text: *Corporal! Any sign of the Chinese yet?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin02Subtitle
text: *No sir, the last message received was at 02:00nothing since

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin03Subtitle
text: *Well, I hope they get here soon. Our intel points to a full-scale GLA attack

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin04Subtitle
text: *Yes, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin06Subtitle
text: *What the...!? Enemy contact!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin07Subtitle
text: *Our base has been breached.all units to your stations! Where are those Chinese we were promised!?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin08Subtitle
text: *Fox in the hole! Fox in the hole!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin09Subtitle
text: *Where'd they come from?!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xCin10Subtitle
text: *They're capturing our buildings! We can't hold! All units, fall back! Repeat, fall back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO01Subtitle
text: *That's it! Power to the US base is down! Finish them quickly before they can rebuild!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO02Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce US units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO03Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The enemy can no longer produce GLA units

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO04Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The US base has been neutralized. Destroy the GLA base to finish this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO05Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. The GLA base has been neutralized. Destroy the US base to finish this battle

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO06Subtitle
text: *We must finish what the US was not able to do. The GLA must fall and the world will be at peace

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO07Subtitle
text: *If we are able to defeat the GLA and save Europe from its clutches then there are great rewards to be had

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO08Subtitle
text: *General, you will take your place among China's finest heroes. The GLA has fallen and China is the shining beacon in a new world. Take you place of honor and bask in the glory that is China

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO09Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has improved their stealth ability, but they do not appear to be using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO10Subtitle
text: *General, the GLA commander is lacking tanks. Perhaps we can overwhelm him with our forces

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO11Subtitle
text: *General, we are losing vehicles to Jarmen Kell. You must track him down if we are to stand a chance

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO12Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy is using HIJACKERS! We need to stop them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO13Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has positioned SNIPERs in the local villages. We must clear them out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO14Subtitle
text: *General, we are losing troops to the enemy's Quad Cannons, we need heavy armor out here

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO15Subtitle
text: *General, current intel suggests Jarmen Kell may be holed up in this small village

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO16Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy's base seems to be on the other side of this river. Perhaps we can lock him in by positioning forces near the bridges

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO17Subtitle
text: *General, we have many driverless vehicles in the fieldsend units to recapture them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO18Subtitle
text: *Sir! We have detected Battle buses in sector C. We should deal with them before they can reach our base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO19Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has slipped units into our base! We should improve our defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO20Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has infiltrated our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO21Subtitle
text: *General! Taking out the American Command Center will put a stop to his heavy Air support

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO22Subtitle
text: *General, we need to get our INTERNET CENTER built as quickly as possible. It will help us locate enemy positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO23Subtitle
text: *General, the enemy has left his Flank unguarded! Now is our chance to counter attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisCHI05xXO24Subtitle
text: *General, the Americans have superior stealth detection technology. Perhaps you should capture this base instead of destroying it

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisChi07RedGuard108Subtitle
text: *Ambush!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion105Subtitle
text: *The Chinese are close

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion108Subtitle
text: *We have found a secret way. It's poorly guarded

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01Scorpion109Subtitle
text: *We're under fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat01Subtitle
text: *Enemy defense structures sighted, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat02Subtitle
text: *Enemy position spotted! We must find a way past them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat03Subtitle
text: *Enemy patrol! All units, open fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat04Subtitle
text: *American Sentry Drones! We must destroy them quickly before they sound the alarm!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat05Subtitle
text: *Look at them scramble! Our attack was a complete surprise!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat06Subtitle
text: *American attackers closing in! We must hold our position, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat07Subtitle
text: *Our surprise was complete! All units, concentrate on their power plants!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xChat08Subtitle
text: *General! We are taking heavy losses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin01Subtitle
text: *Patrol to base: Target has been located and we are in pursuit

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin02Subtitle
text: *Be advised, the bombing campaign has already begun. Be careful, Patrol

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin03Subtitle
text: *Roger that, base. I'm on the right

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin04Subtitle
text: *I'll take the left

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin05Subtitle
text: *I'm taking fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin06Subtitle
text: *Stay on them!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin07Subtitle
text: *Look out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin08Subtitle
text: *Base! Charlie three is down! Repeat: Charlie three is down!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin09Subtitle
text: *Continue pursuit, Charlie two! This is our best shot at him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin10Subtitle
text: *Escorts eliminated! I've got him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin11Subtitle
text: *Nooooo!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin12Subtitle
text: *Heh heh. General, we've made our escape.and are headed for the rendevouz point. The GLA shall rise again

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin13Subtitle
text: *Affirmative. Scout team moving out

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin14Subtitle
text: *This is scout team. We detect no enemy presence. Wait

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin15Subtitle
text: *American ambush! They have us surrounded!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xCin16Subtitle
text: *Sentry Drones! These Americans are most clever. Their drones are hidden when they are still. You must proceed with caution, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen01Subtitle
text: *The Americans have surrounded our stronghold with military checkpoints. You must clear the way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen02Subtitle
text: *General, you must help our true leader escape, so that the GLA can live on

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen03Subtitle
text: *Dr. Thrax may have died for the cause but he was inconsequential. If our brother escapes the US will not have seen the last of the GLA

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen04Subtitle
text: *General. The Fire Base defenses around this American position are too strong. We should avoid a direct confrontation and find another way into the base

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen05Subtitle
text: *Hold you forces back, General. We are sending in a team to scout the other side of the bridge. They will report back on enemy positions

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen06Subtitle
text: *My General. One of our Quick Strike teams has managed to elude their American pursuers, and have agreed to aid us in our mission. Their rocket pods should prove most useful against enemy armor

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen07Subtitle
text: *We have discovered one of our demolitions teams. They will help us to clear a path by destroying the outlying US support bases

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen08Subtitle
text: *General. We must secure the airfield before the transport plane arrives. The survival of the GLA depends on your success

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen09Subtitle
text: *Our Combat Cycles are very versatile. They enhance the abilities of our loyal infantry, and are able to travel over rough terrain. They are even able to survive a jump off cliffs. Use them to bypass American strong-points and attack their vulnerable sides

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen10Subtitle
text: *General! The Americans have sent a second group of pursuers to capture our leader. Protect him at all costs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen11Subtitle
text: *General, this hidden base can provide us with the resources we need to push past the American siege and reach the airfield

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen12Subtitle
text: *General, our leader is under attack! He must not fall to the Americans!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen13Subtitle
text: *General, your forces are moving too far ahead of our leader. Remember that he must reach the airfield if our cause is to survive

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen14Subtitle
text: *Another American base. It must be eliminated. Be wary of their Fire Bases, sir

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen15Subtitle
text: *We are within reach of the airfield, General. Destroy the American forces and secure the area that we may fly our leader to safety

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen16Subtitle
text: *Well done, General. With you in command, we can not fail

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen17Subtitle
text: *We have reached the airfield, sir. Make sure our leader is ready and waiting at the air strip when his plane arrives

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen18Subtitle
text: *Our plane is on approach, General! Just hold your position for a little longer. Our leader must survive to board that plane!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen19Subtitle
text: *The plane has arrived. Load our leader in so that we may fly him to safety and regroup

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen20Subtitle
text: *The plane is waiting for our leader to board. Make haste and bring him in, General. Our forces cannot hold out indefinitely against the Americans

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen21Subtitle
text: *Our operative, Jarmen Kell, has been harassing the American supply lines. He will be of great help to our mission, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen22Subtitle
text: *Excellent work, General. We will show the Americans that we still have the power to resist them

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen23Subtitle
text: *We have discovered an advance scout force, General. They have offered to aid us with our mission

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen24Subtitle
text: *General! Take out the American power plants to shut down their base defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA01xKen25Subtitle
text: *Our forces have been weakened, General. We must choose our battles more wisely

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter04Subtitle
text: *We are here and ready for your command

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02Chatter18Subtitle
text: *So much for American"    superiorite

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02General07Subtitle
text: *American forces are coming. Get ready!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat01Subtitle
text: *The enemy, they are attacking!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat02Subtitle
text: *The resistance is too strong, there must be another way

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat03Subtitle
text: *The Prince must be stopped. The GLA must not fall to him!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat04Subtitle
text: *Our base is under attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat05Subtitle
text: *Our Palace is destroyed!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat06Subtitle
text: *We have lost our Barracks

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xChat07Subtitle
text: *We must rebuild our Arms Dealer quickly

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin01Subtitle
text: *This is Recon 1 to base. I am finishing my patrol. Sector is clear

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin02Subtitle
text: *This is base. Are you certain, Recon 1? We've had reports of troop movements linked to Prince Kassad

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin03Subtitle
text: *I am most certain. I haven't seen anything but dust and shrubs for hours now. Returning to base after this

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin04Subtitle
text: *What the?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin05Subtitle
text: *Recon 1 to base! Enemy contact! Repeat, enemy contact!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin06Subtitle
text: *Recon 1! What is your position?

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin07Subtitle
text: *He's preparing to fire!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin08Subtitle
text: *Recon 1, what is your status? Recon 1! Report!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin09Subtitle
text: *Once Prince Kassad is removed the GLA will be under our control. Then vengeance will be ours and the American infidels will burn

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xCin10Subtitle
text: *Prince Kassad is beginning to take control wherever he can. We must put an end to his vie for power

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen01Subtitle
text: *General, our resources are running low -- we must find a new source of supplies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen02Subtitle
text: *Kassad is attempting to capture nearby resources! We must not let him take what is rightfully ours!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen03Subtitle
text: *We must reunite the GLA under one leader!

label: DIALOGEVENT:MisGLA02xKen04Subtitle
text: *Beware! Kassad has launched a sneak attack against us!
